caption: The drawing depicts a single upright stone object with two distinct sections. The lower section is a rough, unhewn, rectangular block with various shades of beige, brown, and grey, giving it a rugged, natural appearance with irregular texture and edges. The upper section contrasts with the lower by being more refined and features a rounded top. This section is decorated with intricate, symmetrical carvings resembling fern or leaf patterns radiating out from a central point, and contains swirling motifs. The color of this upper part is a muted stone grey, similar in tone to the base but appearing smoother and more uniform. The background of the drawing is plain and a soft beige color, with the shadow beneath the stone suggesting its dimensionality. At the bottom right, the words "ROSE CAMPBELL. CERKE." are inscribed in small, faint letters.
title: Stone Gate Post
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
